digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler - inbound probe dispatch chain and deletion handling
propositions: The (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer because differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes receives a fetched Jira snapshot without jira_key fields, making the loop never emit and all downstream code unreachable in production

Deletion discrimination is already implemented twice in the same pass (outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk.py:187-196) and verified live on DC, making the absent-probe path architecturally redundant

rebar resurrects hard-deleted issues eventually (after 3 confirmed-404 passes retire the binding and unbound-create fires), but prior art (Unito, Kubernetes reconcilers) rejects immediate re-creation, requiring a tombstone guard to prevent resurrection

The(inbound, probe) producer must be removed along with its consumer _apply_inbound_delete and create_after_hard_delete (the same-pass resurrection c244), while a reverse-lookup guard BindingStore.is_retired_local prevents the eventual-resurrection path from re-creating confirmed-deleted issues

The absence-probe port capability (probe_remote, SupportsAbsenceProbe, inbound_probe.py) remains dormant with no live producer after deletion, retained only because removing DC's probe_remote would orphan the shared classify_probe_response classifier per epic e369 AC5
